name: satrak-mobile
description: App de campo de Satrak: rastreo de personal en jornada, misiones y botón de pánico.

scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.test: tsc src/api/client.ts src/api/types.ts src/tracking/shift.ts --outDir .testbuild --target ES2019 --module ES2020 --moduleResolution bundler && node test/shift.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: tsc src/api/client.ts src/api/types.ts src/tracking/shift.ts --outDir .testbuild --target ES2019 --module ES2020 --moduleResolution bundler && node test/api.e2e.mjs
